rubric_policy: Keep the original calibration rubrics. Only phase, local data/output paths and execution instructions change for main tasks. No new semantic examples or rules.
known_limitations: Both judges conflate nationality and legal citizenship in some calibration cases.
Explicit approximation and missing temporal roles are not handled consistently with strict equivalence.
Binary correctness and completeness may be conflated; a weaker assertion can still be supported.
Negation expressed in both predicate wording and polarity has no fully validated interpretation.
Agreement between judges is not accuracy, and Sonnet is not human ground truth.
Calibration has been discussed, but no independent human reference labels or judge error rate have been established.
stopping_policy: No new extraction, merger prompt, judge model, calibration pass or quality-conditioned retry in E08.
Retain failed and pending inputs in the fixed frame; never replace them or use heuristic fallback.
One judgment per main item; a continuation may process missing IDs, not revise existing labels.
Budget exhaustion yields an incomplete result, not automatic resampling or a model switch.
Close E08 with a report, including negative or inconclusive results. No automatic collection-1000.

budget.note: This decision file is not a spending limiter. Use an OpenRouter key credit limit and account for OpenCode session overhead and reasoning.
